data.action: 扛着熔光大剑稳步前行
data.description: 【莱瓦汀 · 冰原行军】终末地工业开辟的极寒冰原之上，莱瓦汀单手扛着散发着耀眼熔岩赤芒的重型动力大剑，沉重的战靴在厚厚的坚冰上踩出阵阵白雾。她甩开火红色的长发回眸露出狂放好战的笑容——「冰原的严寒根本不值一提！管理员，前方的侵蚀体巢穴已经锁定，看我一剑把它们全部烧成灰烬！」
data.lighting: pale ice light with warm sword glow
data.promptProse: Laevatain marches across the frozen field with a heavy powered greatsword balanced on one shoulder, turning her red-haired head back with a fierce grin. Her black layered combat dress, loose one-shoulder jacket and knee boots remain fully framed. Pale ice light brightens the ground beyond her path; molten-red sword glow warms her glove and collar, while each heavy step raises white vapor against the colder distant ice.
data.title: 莱瓦汀 · 冰原行军
